Select: drug ChEMBL ID, drug preferred name, MeSH ID, MeSH heading, EFO ID (aliased as indication_curie), EFO term (aliased as indication_label), and max phase for indication. Source: molecule_dictionary and drug_indication tables. Join: molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter: max_phase_for_ind equals 4. Sort: by drug ChEMBL ID, drug preferred name, MeSH ID, MeSH heading, EFO ID, EFO term, and max phase for indication.
